name: Sideline notebook
approvalScope: Visual direction selected during shaping; not a completed application or a pixel-exact implementation specification.
selectionScope: Visual direction for the tryout evaluation and team placement brief; application implementation has not been requested.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: One full-fidelity north-star mobile UI design comp for Pino, a youth sports tryout evaluation and team placement application.
Primary request: Generate a single portrait 1024x1536 full-bleed mobile application viewport, no device frame, for the SIDELINE NOTEBOOK concept. A coach's working notebook translated into crisp modern software. Structure and useful information come first. This is an operational app screenshot, not a poster or marketing page.
Screen structure top to bottom:
1. Compact deep navy index/header band. Pino wordmark at left; small visible "Sample data" label at right. Beneath, concise club/context: "Northside FC" and "Spring 2027 tryout", plus a large enough back control with left arrow and "Roster". Compact progress strip immediately beneath header: "48 players" and "19 awaiting decision".
2. Strong selected-player identity on white. Eyebrow "PLAYER", large bold "Avery Morgan", supporting "Graduation year 2031", clear restrained pill "Awaiting decision". This identity is dominant, legible at arm's length outdoors.
3. Note writing panel appears immediately under player identity and before existing notes. Section title "Add shared note". Comfortable multiline text input with visible placeholder "Add an observation…" and explicitly labeled large cobalt "Save note" action. Brief low-emphasis helper "Visible to coaches and administrators." Keep the composer compact enough that recent observations stay visible in this same viewport.
4. Immediately below, "Shared observations". Two clean stacked observations divided by fine rules, NOT bubbles or an ornamental card grid. Each has a small author initial circle, prominent author, small timestamp, then readable note body. First: author "Coach Sam", time "10:42 AM", exact note "Checks shoulder before receiving; confident turning into space." Second: author "Coach Lee", time "10:36 AM", exact note "Looked comfortable with either foot in the small-sided game."
5. Lower area provides a full-width outlined secondary action "Record decision". Subtle support line "Placed · Withdrawn · Not selected". Preserve the fact that outcomes can be revised and a player has one current team per season; if small explanatory copy fits, use "Decisions can be revised." Do not show a team or a decided outcome for Avery because Avery is awaiting decision.

Visual system:
Palette exactly white #FFFFFF, deep navy #202C42, focused cobalt #244D9E, and pale cool blue #E7EDF6. Strong white-on-navy index bands; white content ground with fine cool divider rules. Workhorse sans-serif typography, tightly disciplined type hierarchy, large clear player name, readable note copy. Wide, comfortable tap targets; daylight legibility; generous but purposeful spacing. Flat crisp surfaces, modest corner radii, almost no shadow. Polished real product UI with precise alignment and high quality rendering, retain full visible text. Avoid wasting space on browser chrome, mobile OS status bars, or decorative graphics.
Constraints: Use all named sample facts faithfully. Notes only: no numeric scores, ratings, rankings, scorecards or skill rubrics. No offline/sync promises. No approvals or recommendation handoff. No parent contact, messaging, notifications, payment, or player photographs. No speculative team assignments. No cream paper texture, handwriting, skeuomorphic notebook bindings, paper shadows, physical phone frame, poster title, illustration, gradients or oversized empty hero. The concept name SIDELINE NOTEBOOK is not visible in the app. This is clearly fictional sample data.
notes: Selected planning concept with fictional sample data. Application implementation has not been requested.
